title: Notion as the company wiki for a 40-person team
prompt: Score Notion as a company wiki for our 40-person team.
note: Letter grades on a four-point scale, because the reader is a leadership team that thinks in report-card terms and the scale makes a C+ on search legible without a legend. The overall is a large letter in a brand badge, each dimension is a row with its letter and a short bar plus an evidence line, strengths and weaknesses are two plain bulleted columns with no icons, and the comparables are a small table so Confluence and Slab can be read dimension by dimension against Notion on one screen. Light, sans, calm, with every section directly on the background.
